I have been trying to start working out consistently, eat better, stop drinking alcohol. This app has pushed me to do these things. My favorite App I have ever come across. A simple concept but so so so helpful to push me to to be a better person.

title.label: Keeping it simple…. While having powerful features

content.label:
A great app if you are trying  to reinforce some changes.

On the surface, this app is simple and super easy to use (like lots of similar apps).  Dive a bit dealer and you find JUST ENOUGH advanced features to make the app more useful when you want.  A favorite feature = the simple prompt to check off a habit yesterday.  It is going to happen that, 1 day ago, you DID do that thing… you just did not check it off at that moment.  A subtitle reminder to stay focused and track your progress.  

The organization of “pages” of habits allows me to create a morning routine that is visually separate from evening or those habits not connected to a time of day.  And I can have habits that are weekly (or multiple times per week) on a separate “page”.

But it should be easy to track habit completion as the app works on every Apple device I own…phone, iPad, watch and Mac.  Syncing coul be a little faster but eventually it does get “current”.
Life chaning, I am using it both for mysel fand my 7yo now
I had an issue where completing tasks from notifications wouldn’t always work correctly.  And… the developers actually fixed it within a couple of weeks?!  It’s been flawless since.

title.label: Quality, Colorful, Useful, for a PRICE

content.label: 5 stars because this is truly a 5 star app, it has some real love poured into it with no ads and lots of customization. But for $5.99? It seems a little heavy, but not steep enough for a 4 star review. Wonderful app 👍

I’m not usually one to write reviews, but if you are on the fence on this app, it’s well worth the small fee.   

Most people don’t change their life and every aspect of it overnight.  It comes through building healthy habits that you can sustain.   

Wake up and have a healthy snack.  Go for a short walk daily.   Spend 15 minutes reading a few days a week.  

By slowly building healthy consistent habits that you can maintain and sustain you can change your entire life in a way you won’t even recognize your old self.   

This app helps you do that!

This app would be acceptable if it were free, but for a paid app, I expect more. 

1) Setting up notifications is difficult and requires a separate step outside of setting up the task. The notifications should be able to be set up per sub task. It would be better if you could edit a task and set a notification time for each sub task. 
2) Notifications are not reliable on Apple Watch. I only get a 2 notifications per day on a task with 5 sub tasks. 
3) If I complete all sub tasks early in the day, I still get notifications later in the day. Having the ability to add a notification time per sub task might help solve this as the notifications would not be completely separate from the tasks themselves. 
4) I can’t figure out how to edit a future task. I can only edit tasks that are scheduled for the current day. 

I love the idea of this app but it is missing a huge amount of polish.

title.label: Amazing and very much worth it

content.label: They thought of everything. Some settings are a little bit hidden but legitimately everything I wanted they have. I love that you just pay once and it’s not a subscription. This is the best app and has quite literally changed my life and allowed me to follow through with better habits. Been using it for 9 months now. Wish I found it sooner.
I just love apps that do what they are supposed to do.

As someone who suffers from ADHD, I often felt overwhelmed by the sheer number of tasks I needed to complete. It reached a point where my mind would shut down, and instead of tackling at least one task, I ended up doing nothing at all.

Using the Streaks app has been a game-changer for me. It has transformed my life by helping me monitor and track my tasks effectively. Now, I finally have control over my daily routines!

Thank you so much for this incredible app! One suggestion: please consider adding more pages to monitor additional tasks. I need more space to keep track of everything. Please !!!!!

Reasonably priced.

title.label: Get This App – also a suggestion!

content.label:
This app is great. I have had it since around 2019 and seeing the useful updates, ability to comment, and other development shows.

When I first used this app I added too many tasks, got overwhelmed, didn’t want to open it cause it was too much, than stopped using it after a month…

I picked it back up again and kept it simple. Over the past year it has developed into an essential tool for my day. Just 6 streaks. The customization and flexibility is great. Especially with notifications, badge icons, and SHORTCUT INTEGRATION. I am reading, working out, watching less YouTube and learning more as a result. Daily small changes and improvements in my life. Keep is small and build on those habits! I love being able to comment on different complete actions and track the stats.

Improvement suggestion: When you assign an ‘Action Button’ to ‘Incomplete Task’ you can only choose/check one action… This means that if you have a timed task, and want to start the timer and have it run a shortcut you can’t do both. It would be great if I could launch a shortcut and have it start the timer in the app!

Thanks if you read this far! Keep up the work. Worth every penny.

Practically everyone has a need for a habit tracker. Streaks strikes just the right balance between ease of use and richness of features. An Apple Design Winner, Streaks makes it easy to create up to 24 habits to track daily or at user-determined intervals. It ties in with Apple Health and can automatically determine things like your step count, heart rate and recorded blood pressure. It can help you remember other habits like journaling, dog-walking, language practice and more. It's a universal app with editions for iOS, Apple Watch and macOS - all synced with iCloud. It even provides detailed charts and graphs on your progress and completion rate over time

Needs improvement.  24 tasks are too few and you are confined to 28 characters for tasks you add. Nice interface but unusable for me. Hopefully changes will be made. Overall needs more flexibility. More space to add a sentence to yourself on your task.

The level of detail the creators went into to make this app is remarkable. It is intuitive, well thought out and easy to use. 

It helps me to organize my day. As an ADHD person, it keeps me on top of the things that I need to and want to do. My life has improved from this app, which is a bit of a funny thing to say. But true

I've been using Streaks for a few months now, and I've been impressed with how the developers have built feature after feature that normal habit-forming apps don't have.

However, I must express some doubt as to whether "streaks" are the best way to maintain a habit. I find that often after I break a streak, there is no motive to continue since my number has been broken.

I recommend Streaks study the data about how many people actually pick up habits consistently again after breaking a very long streak.

Maybe there can be some sort of redemption mechanic. Perhaps a gold-day can allow someone to resume their past streak of 1-2 lapsed items? Just a suggestion, as I really appreciate having an app like Streaks to help me form and keep to my habits but find it all too easy to break down into dysfunction after just one "bad day."

This looked like a winner, something simple. I entered a habit, marked it off and……nothing. No indication the item had been completed. 6 or 7 taps later I guess I made it to a summary screen, but nothing was showing as completed. Notifications still showed I had all my daily habits yet to do.

My best guess is everything gets recorded at 12 midnight or something? 

You simply cannot mark a habit complete and have it register anywhere. Will be requesting a refund. Save your money, a google sheet would be a better alternative.
